paragraphs.paragraph_text: We depend on reliable technology systems. A failure or security incident affecting our systems or third-party providers could harm customer trust and business continuity.
Evolving data protection, competition, and product-safety requirements may require substantial changes to our business practices.
Demand may be affected by macroeconomic conditions, customer budgets, product cycles, and the availability of competing products.

Management continues to monitor revenue growth, operating expenses, working capital, and capital allocation.
